title: Alabama Power Maintains Regulatory Influence and Record Profits
summary: Alabama Power avoided tighter regulation while maintaining record profits through its influence over the state legislature.

title: NYC Releases Documents Revealing Air Quality Risks After 9/11 at World Trade Center
summary: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani released previously undisclosed documents suggesting air quality concerns at the World Trade Center after the September 11 attacks contradicted statements from former mayors Bloomberg and Giuliani.

title: Alabama legislature's collision with Alabama Power delayed by spring break amid renewable energy dispute
summary: Alabama lawmakers deferred action on landmark electricity legislation when they broke for spring, preventing a showdown with Alabama Power over rates and renewable energy.

title: Marmot project leverages online culture and meme coin donations to fund wildlife research
summary: The Marmot Project has used Fat Bear Week-style public engagement, OnlyFans partnerships, and meme coin fundraising to secure major funding for wildlife biology research.

title: Three-Year Research Project Investigates UK Shark Species Conservation
summary: A collaborative science project with anglers will study UK shark species including porbeagle, tope, and blue shark to improve conservation efforts.

title: Man arrested for smuggling critically endangered crocodile head through Italian airport
summary: An Italian man faces criminal charges and potential prison time after authorities discovered the dried head of a critically endangered crocodile in his luggage at Turin airport.

title: Welsh farm charity supplies fresh produce to Birmingham children
summary: A Welsh farming charity grows and delivers substantial harvests of vegetables and salad crops to urban Birmingham children.
